name: Fatalis Trio
description: (Tag:breeding)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:earth)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)A trio of Fatalis, apex Elder Dragons able to raze castles and ruin countries overnight, all with immense power and regeneration. Regular Fatalis vaporizes steel with firepower; Crimson Fatalis is stronger but unstable, wielding magma and meteors; eldest White Fatalis is strongest, wielding Red Lightning infused with Dragon Energy and energy beams. Reproduction unknown, but you can probably figure it out.
